subject: Onboarding playbook, staging windows & go-live timeline
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
To: Amelia Ross <amelia.ross@stellarsupply.com>, Procurement <procurement@stellarsupply.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 20 Dec 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Onboarding playbook, staging windows & go-live timeline

Hi Amelia / Stella procurement team —

Great to be moving forward. As discussed in Friday's call, attached is a first-pass onboarding playbook and a proposed timeline. High-level goals: get a small pilot integration (API + SSO) running in a staging environment, validate inference latency and cost targets against your sample traffic, and then schedule a controlled go-live with a fallback rollback window.

Key milestones below (owners tentative):
- Discovery & sample data exchange (by 2027-01-05) — Owner: Amelia / Stella engineering
- Staging provision & API key handover (by 2027-01-12) — Owner: Ben Carter (Redwood)
- SSO integration (SAML) smoke + test (by 2027-01-19) — Owner: Marissa Cole (Redwood) / Stella IdP team
- Performance validation (latency/cost) on sample load (by 2027-01-26) — Owners: Naomi Feldman (Customer Success) / Stella eng
- Go-live cutover window (target) 2027-02-02 02:00-04:00 UTC — Owner: Jordan Blake (release coordination)

Acceptance criteria we will use for go/no-go (short):
- End-to-end median latency < 350ms for 95th percentile token workloads in staging
- Request success rate >= 99.5% over a 24h smoke window
- Stable KV cache hit rate above our baseline after warmup tests

I've attached: MAP_Stellar_20261220.pdf (mutual action plan with owners & checkpoints) and the draft SOW SOW_Stellar_v0.9.docx. Please review and tell us which items you want moved or clarified.

Next step: can we lock the discovery slot for next Wednesday (2026-12-23) at 10:00 PT? If that works, Ben will kick off provisioning tasks and share the pre-provision checklist.

Thanks —
Jordan Blake
Enterprise Lead, Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwood.ai
From: Amelia Ross <amelia.ross@stellarsupply.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@stellarsupply.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 21 Dec 2026 11:08:00 -05:00
Subject: Re: Onboarding playbook, staging windows & go-live timeline

Jordan —

Thanks for the clear plan and the attachments. We reviewed the MAP and overall it looks sensible. A couple of clarifying requests from our side before we lock dates: 
1) For the discovery/sample data exchange, can you confirm the exact formats you support (JSONL, Parquet for embeddings export)?
2) For SSO, we need to confirm whether Redwood supports attribute-mapping for our user roles (we use group-based role mapping).
3) Procurement needs the SOW to show a 30-day payment term and an explicit cancellation window in case performance targets are not met during the pilot.

Discovery slot on 2026-12-23 10:00 PT works for our engineers. I'll add our IdP contact (cc'ed) to that meeting invite.

—Amelia
Amelia Ross
Head of Product, Stellar Supply Co.
amelia.ross@stellarsupply.com
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Amelia Ross <amelia.ross@stellarsupply.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 22 Dec 2026 08:22:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Onboarding playbook, staging windows & go-live timeline

Amelia — quick responses inline and an updated note about timeline.

1) Data formats: we support JSONL for request/response logs and embeddings export as either JSONL or Parquet. For the pilot, JSONL payloads are easiest to validate. I'll include a sample schema in the MAP appendix.

2) SSO attribute mapping: yes — Redwood's SAML connector supports group attributes and role mapping. We'll add a step to the playbook to exchange attribute names and a short test plan (test users + expected roles). Marissa will own that integration.

3) SOW / procurement: Jordan / Naomi — we can accept 30-day net terms. For the pilot cancellation clause, we'll add a 14-day performance review clause tied to the acceptance criteria; if targets aren't met, either side can pause the rollout with no penalty. Draft update attached.

UPDATED MILESTONE TIMETABLE (small shift to accommodate holidays):
- Discovery & sample data exchange — new target 2027-01-04 (Owner: Amelia / Stella)
- Staging provision & API key handover — 2027-01-11 (Owner: Ben Carter)
- SSO mapping + test users — 2027-01-18 (Owner: Marissa Cole / Stella IdP)
- Performance validation (24h smoke) — 2027-01-25 (Owner: Naomi Feldman / Stella eng)
- Go-live cutover window — 2027-02-03 02:00-04:00 UTC (Owner: Jordan Blake)

Attachments included: MAP_Stellar_20261220.pdf (updated appendix), SOW_Stellar_v0.9.docx (procurement edits).

Ben Carter
Implementation Lead, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
To: Amelia Ross <amelia.ross@stellarsupply.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>, Procurement <procurement@stellarsupply.com>
Date: Tue, 22 Dec 2026 15:40:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Onboarding playbook, staging windows & go-live timeline

Thanks everyone — happy to lock in those dates. Quick checklist / next actions before discovery: 
- Amelia: share sample payloads (JSONL preferred) + IdP attribute schema by EOD 2026-12-28.
- Stella procurement: confirm acceptance of 30-day terms and the pilot cancellation clause; once confirmed, we'll issue the updated SOW for signature (DocuSign link below).
- Ben: provision staging cluster and share pre-provision checklist 48 hours before 2027-01-11.
- Marissa: prepare SSO test plan and a short runbook for smoke test (2 test users + role mapping verifications).
- Naomi: draft runbook for performance validation and define the exact metrics collection window.

DocuSign: https://www.docusign.com/room/1234-ss-sign
HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/12345

We'll treat the 2027-02-03 UTC window as the primary cutover; Jordan will run the release war room and Naomi will coordinate post-cutover monitoring for 24 hours. If anything looks off, we execute the rollback plan in the MAP (revert routing to canary model and restore prior caching state).

If this reads correctly I will send the updated SOW into DocuSign tonight and calendar the discovery slot for 12/23 10:00 PT.

Jordan Blake
Enterprise Lead, Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwood.ai
